conventions: byte strings are 0x-prefixed lowercase hex; `preimage` is the 199-byte control-leaf preimage and `ton_b1`/`ton_b2` its two TON HASHEXT builders (125 + 74 bytes); scenario rows follow committee_transitions_v1.json. The Taira blocks of `destination_effects` are synthetic destination inputs: every scenario starts from a fresh destination, and the control nonces of a block are chosen for that scenario, so they need not follow Taira's dense per-revision sequence (§4.14.6 step 1)

destination_effects.description: CX-3: a Parliament pause, then a fast pause, then the lapse; the Parliament pause stays in force
destination_effects.name: parliament_pause_then_fast_pause_then_lapse

destination_effects.description: CX-3: the fast pause, then a Parliament pause whose leaf carries the live fast pause; after the lapse the Parliament pause remains
destination_effects.name: fast_pause_then_parliament_pause_then_lapse

destination_effects.description: CX-4: a fast-pause leaf delivered after its expiry consumes its nonce and does not pause
destination_effects.name: track2_leaf_after_expiry

destination_effects.description: newest nonce wins: 3 applied, 2 and 3 stale, 5 accepted across the gap
destination_effects.name: stale_equal_and_gap_nonces

destination_effects.description: fast_pause_until_ms 40 days ahead is clamped to now + MAX_FAST_PAUSE_MS
destination_effects.name: max_fast_pause_clamp

destination_effects.description: minting is paused while now < fastPauseUntilMs and resumes at the expiry with no relay; voids and checkpoints work while paused
destination_effects.name: fast_pause_local_expiry

destination_effects.description: a Parliament pause (nonce 1) then a resume (nonce 2) in one block
destination_effects.name: pause_then_resume

destination_effects.description: a control of block 1010 proven through the history path of X_1100
destination_effects.name: historical_control_proof

destination_effects.description: leaves of another network, Taira network, revision or destination, a transfer leaf offered as a control, and a recorded leaf violating a constraint
destination_effects.name: foreign_and_malformed_controls
